sources.quote: Torino Plant 3 (TO3) is not in scope of this record.
APPROVAL AP-0208: part BR-180; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6061-T6; status APPROVED 2024-10-14 (PPAP-2024-091)

findings.why: The change moves BR-180 pilot builds for STL to Plant 3 (TO3). Alluminio B's approval is for TO1 only, and the ASL does not cover TO3. No controlled record covers part, plant and customer for TO3, so this cannot be read as 'not approved'. Someone must confirm whether TO3 has a release for this source.

sources.quote: Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The pilot builds would use billet from Alluminio B Settimo. The documents contain no material certificate or test result for that billet or lot against EN AW-6061-T6, which BOM-LINE 110 requires. A person must supply it.
